lines.text: David wrote this psalm for the choirmaster, to be played with trumpets.
David asks how long men will love vanity and seek lies, and says the LORD hears him.
David says to be angry yet not sin, offer the sacrifices of the righteous, and go up to Jerusalem.
David asks the LORD to shine the light of His face upon them and says God filled his heart with joy.
David will lie down and sleep in peace because the LORD alone makes him dwell in safety.
